alt: The new Packard Bell DotBook laptop displayed alongside the DotLoop suitcase-style vinyl turntable at IFA 2026, representing the brand's relaunch as a lifestyle brand under Acer
story: Acer relaunched the Packard Bell brand at IFA 2026 to mark its centennial, repositioning the company that helped democratize the beige desktop PC as a 'lifestyle brand' — whose inaugural product line includes a suitcase-style vinyl turntable, audio glasses, a 4G feature phone, and a connected mini-steamer alongside the obligatory laptop.
why_funny: The brand that spent a century going from consumer radios to color televisions to cheap unreliable PCs has now found its hundred-year destiny: a Wi-Fi-connected clothes steamer.
